Do I need to download a special app?

Put the pages on a flat surface in a contrasting color so the app can detect the edges. The app straightens each page automatically.

To a cloud file store such as Dropbox, or by email. Use the output icon in the upper right.

Yes. The Files app can create a similar scanned document.
